summary: Complete implementation plan for FinScore AI — a 28-file full-stack project spanning Spring Boot 3.2 (Java 17), FastAPI (Python), Thymeleaf templates, XGBoost ML model, LangChain RAG pipeline, and MySQL database. Organized in 6 phases: skeleton, ML service, Spring Boot backend, Thymeleaf frontend, static assets, and deployment config. Includes architecture diagram, file manifest, open questions about deployment and ML approach, and verification plan.
